test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
If ABCD is a rhombus such that ∠ACB = 50°, then ∠BDC will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7440c861e04fc079da8c4d9ae5ebce06a4b243062f2f91a2a761e1a5ff9c86a7.png]
solution:
**Concept used**:

The opposite angles of a rhombus are equal.

The diagonal of a rhombus bisects the angle through which it passes.

**Solution**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b15eaf6d56cba7e5af580dbfcd855afc7fa080caf7c94eeeccb1cc1e696c04c.png] 

∠OCB = 50° = ∠OCD

∠COD = ∠BOC = 90° 

In an ΔOCD, we know that

∠OCD + ∠DOC + ∠ODC = 180° 

50° + 90° + ∠ODC = 180° 

∠ODC = 180° - 90° - 50°

∠ODC = 40° = ∠BDC

**Hence, the correct option is 40°.**
